verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS MCP registry, gateway and chat platform, but the evidence pack never documents any way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The gateway docs instead say every call is logged. The 'private by default' setting controls server listing visibility, not tracking, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
